title: Major disaster declaration DR-4925-MI: Flood
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4925-MI, "SEVERE STORMS, TORNADOES, AND FLOODING") for MI, dated 2026-06-30, for an incident of type "Flood". The incident period began on 2026-04-10 and ended on 2026-04-21. The declaration lists 37 designated areas.
